subject.facility_name: LAUREL RIDGE CENTER FOR HEALTH & REHABILITATION

executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $196.03 per resident day (42.9% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was -6.0% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $492,262, 6.5% of the $7,589,665 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,501,049, $38.77 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $830,230 (55.3%), allocated fringe $240,001 (16.0%), non-wage costs $430,818 (28.7%). Raw food was $358,683 ($9.26 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $15,008.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $490,261, $12.66 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $337,140 (68.8%), allocated fringe $97,460 (19.9%), non-wage costs $55,661 (11.4%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $356,859, $9.22 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $226,937 (63.6%), allocated fringe $65,602 (18.4%), non-wage costs $64,320 (18.0%).
Missing data: cost year 2015 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2015 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; nursing hours per resident day outside the plausible range; direct care share of expenses outside the plausible range; revenue per resident day outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; payer days do not add up to the printed total). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
